trustRules: The target nickname, signature, local-mode badge, dash counts, archive status, sample template names and just-saved timestamps are visual examples, not runtime facts.
Profile identity comes only from AuthClient.profile(), which merges the authenticated account with the local profile draft. A nickname or avatar is never inferred from the target.
The avatar slot renders a returned avatarUrl only when present; otherwise it retains a neutral silhouette. Image failure cannot promote the placeholder into a user identity claim.
Profile edits are local-first through saveProfileDraft. Account synchronization is claimed only when the backend returns a non-fallback profile with an account identity.

Template counts and recent rows come only from TemplateRepository.fetch()/list(). Remote templates are merged into local storage; transport fallback is explicitly local or stale rather than backend-verified.
The two recent-save positions are stable. Missing positions say unavailable and cannot copy target sample names or timestamps.
Template deletion always requires confirmation. The UI reports the repository result and reloads current data; it cannot claim remote deletion when the endpoint fell back to local deletion.
Character/server and profession preference values use only explicit AuthUser fields. Missing fields remain 未设置 and the target does not authorize invented player identity.
Data-source state is derived from the route response and template.remote flags. Local mode, mixed mode and account-synced mode are distinct states.
The four-item ProductTabBar is shared product navigation. Its current shared label/icon and geometry debt must be fixed in the shared owner, never with profile-private overrides.

Loading, stale, empty and error states retain all seven target regions and stable counts; route state is expressed inside target-owned profile/template surfaces rather than generic RouteStatePanel cards.

mappings.runtime: AppShell tab-root surface and fixed profile composition
PageFrame profile variant with centered 我的 title
returned/local profile identity, storage mode and three real archive metrics
two stable talent/gear entry actions with real counts
two latest repository templates or stable unavailable positions, plus confirmed delete
four stable rows using explicit profile/storage facts and supported local actions
shared four-item ProductTabBar with profile selected

stateContract.initial_loading: mount all seven regions with final geometry, local profile facts and neutral template positions while the repository request is pending
stateContract.ready_remote: render merged repository templates and account-backed mode only from a successful response
stateContract.stale_local: retain local templates and visibly identify local fallback without removing any target region
stateContract.empty: retain three metrics, two category entries and two unavailable recent positions with zero real counts
stateContract.delete: confirm, execute repository deletion, report local versus remote result truthfully and reload
stateContract.profile_edit: save a bounded nickname locally first; optionally use explicit WeChat user-profile authorization
stateContract.resume: tab resume reloads templates without collapsing the composition
